# Nexus Game Launcher v2.8.1 - Settings Scroll Hotfix

This maintenance release fixes a Settings navigation issue reported after v2.8.0. It retains the features and Windows runtime improvements from v2.8.0.

## Fixed

- Selecting Full, Medium, or Mini Display in Modal Overlay settings no longer scrolls the outer Settings workspace out of view.
- The Launcher Settings heading, General / Appearance / Modal Overlay / Backup & Vault tabs, and Save Settings footer remain in place while the selected panel scrolls independently.
- Radio controls for layout, screen corner, modal size and window size retain focus inside their own cards, including keyboard navigation and RTL/LTR layouts.
- Live preview sizing and saved overlay configuration are unchanged.

## Scope

This is a Settings UI and release-metadata hotfix, not a new overlay engine. Native graphics components, session monitoring, restart guards, asset providers, backups, and dependency versions are unchanged from v2.8.0.

The fix was reproduced in Chromium and confirmed in the Nexus development application. Windows release packaging is subject to the same build and executable verification gates as v2.8.0. See the [v2.8.0 release](https://github.com/AliAl-ojeely/nexus-game-launcher/releases/tag/v2.8.0) for the full feature list.

## Experimental feature warning

The in-game Modal Overlay remains experimental, Windows-only, and disabled by default. Use it only with supported offline games without anti-cheat. Direct3D 11, Direct3D 9 and OpenGL are experimental supported backends; Direct3D 12 remains incomplete/disabled, Vulkan is unverified, and Windows ARM64 overlay runtime is unsupported. Compatibility varies by game and system.

## Updating

Use Check for Updates from v2.8.0, or download the matching installer from this release. Keep a backup of your Nexus data before updating. The release includes Windows NSIS, Linux x64/ARM64 AppImages, macOS universal DMG, and SHA256SUMS.txt after the release build succeeds.
